core_problem: Brain tumor segmentation is challenging due to class imbalance and limited model generalization, hindering accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.
methodology_summary: The study evaluates U-Net segmentation performance on brain tumor MRI using focal loss and basic data augmentation strategies (horizontal flip, rotation, and scaling).
empirical_results: The U-Net with focal loss achieved a precision of 90%, comparable to state-of-the-art results.
explicit_limitations: Manual delineation by radiologists is time-consuming, prone to inter-observer variability, and difficult to scale in clinical settings.
